x: Our own John Davies, Brian Morris, Clive Ryan, Frank Wright and D. McCorquindale were competing elsewhere, and with Stan Vickers Eric Hall, Norman Caves, Mal Ash and Andorka also unavailable our team could not be said to be truly representative of the name of Belgrave.

Making a valuable contribution to our points, D.McCorquindale scored a double in the shot and discus, with 47 and 120 ft respectively. After dropping out of the 5¾ at Wimbledon, Trevor Hart dashed down to Hurlingham to win the mile, with 4:48 - running in bare feet!
